resources.string: SSH keys that give one server or device access to this repository only
No deploy keys yet. A deploy key lets one server, device or script (a CI, a backup job, Termux) pull this repository over SSH, without your account. Tap + to add one.
Public key: ssh-ed25519 AAAA… (the contents of a .pub file)
With write access, anyone who has the private key can push to this repository and delete branches.
This is a PRIVATE key. Never share it: paste the public key instead (the file that ends in .pub).
This is not an SSH public key. It starts with ssh-ed25519, ssh-rsa or ecdsa-sha2-….
GitHub does not accept this key type. Use ssh-ed25519, ssh-rsa or ecdsa.
